node.statement: For arbitrary W and data satisfying the root hypotheses, set t_3:=W.K3*epsilon. Since W.K3>=1 and 0<=epsilon<=W.e_cross/W.K3, W.e_cross is nonnegative and multiplication by the positive W.K3 yields 0<=t_3<=W.e_cross<=e_cross^0; also epsilon<=t_3. Moreover W.K3>=K_3^0, W.e_cross<=e_cross^0, and K_3^0=max{1,e_cross^0/e_env^0} give epsilon<=e_cross^0/K_3^0<=e_env^0. Hence 0<=epsilon<=e_env^0 and 0<=epsilon<=t_3<=W.e_cross<=e_cross^0.
